title: A minor triad
summary: Move the middle sound a half step lower.

steps.title: A minor triad
steps.body:
**minor triad** means a triad with notes three and seven half steps above its root. A minor uses A, C and E: C is three half steps above A, and E is seven. Major would use four half steps for that middle sound.

**Why it matters:** One changed note makes a different chord. Keep the root and compare the middle sound carefully.

steps.title: Read and hear the notes
steps.body: Try A3 at string 3 fret 2, C4 at string 2 fret 1 and E4 at open string 1.

items.prompt: Play A, C, E together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Compare A, C, E with A, C#, E one note at a time. Return to C for A minor. Chord checks accept any octave for the three names.
